acceptanceCriteria: A1: strict repository-bound recovery receipt records retry or successor decision and predecessor digests
A2: stale or blocked predecessor remains immutable and cannot be silently promoted
A3: retry path requires fresh current evidence and successor path creates explicit predecessor binding
A4: foreign malformed duplicate and symlinked recovery receipts fail closed
A5: CLI MCP and tri-language Outcome expose recovery decision and resume condition consistently
goal: Bind every retry or successor to immutable predecessor evidence without rewriting historical bytes
intent: Introduce explicit retry and successor recovery receipts for stale or blocked Work Items

scenarioCoverage.scenario: recovery receipt tamper and predecessor binding
scenarioCoverage.expected: Foreign malformed duplicate and symlinked receipts are rejected and valid retry or successor preserves predecessor digests
scenarioCoverage.verificationPlan: Run focused protocol repository CLI and MCP recovery tests and retain the installed Runtime verification receipt
